context.title: Rent or buy a house
context.last_summary: Savings make buying feasible. Rent stays the default until stay, cost and reserve are proven.
open_questions: How much cash would remain after the down payment, stamp duty and registration?
What monthly rent have you found for comparable homes in the same area?
What is the minimum number of years you are confident you would stay?
